en.p: For a natural number $a\le 6$, the following trial is performed using one die and one coin.

box: If the number rolled is less than or equal to $a$, toss the coin 5 times and record the number of heads;
if the number rolled is greater than $a$, toss the coin 3 times and record the number of heads.

en.p: This trial is repeated 19200 times, and let $X$ be the number of times the recorded number is 3. When $\mathrm{E}(X)=4800$, the value of $\mathrm{P}(X\le 4800+30a)$ obtained using the standard normal table below is $k$. Find the value of $1000\times k$. [4 points]
